title: Bedrock Sleeping Animation
description: A port of the sleeping animation from Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.
body:
# Bedrock Sleeping Animation

## Description:
This mod replaces the _boring_ Java sleeping animation with the **_fancy_** bedrock one!

It's client side and can be used on Servers!
